title: Breton Technology Drops Planned Stake Purchase in Xingmiao Photoelectric
Breton Technology Co., Ltd. cancelled the acquisition of 6.8281% stake in Shanghai Xingmiao Photoelectric Technology Co., Ltd.
Breton Technology Co., Ltd. (SEHK:1333) annule l’acquisition d’une participation de 6,8281 % dans Shanghai Xingmiao Photoelectric Technology Co., Ltd.
